summary: Example group_vars/routeros.yml with network_cli and community.network.routeros; to fix timeouts add +cet1024w to the username, which disables colours, uses dumb mode and sets width 1024.
questions: How do I fix timeouts connecting to MikroTik with Ansible?
What does +cet1024w do in a RouterOS username?
What group_vars do I need for RouterOS?

answer_card.title: RouterOS group_vars and timeout tip
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: community.network.routeros
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_password: !vault...
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
**Timeouts?** Append `+cet1024w` to the username (for example `myuser+cet1024w`). It disables console colours, enables "dumb" mode, skips terminal detection and sets width to 1024 columns.

Drop the password with SSH keys and the proxy line for direct access.
